name: Audit
description: A pluggable site-audit framework: each submodule contributes AuditAnalyzer plugins that score site health (security, performance, SEO, cache, fields, code quality, etc.), surfaced on an admin report and via Drush; optional DruScan portal sync.
project_description:
Audit is a framework that scores the health of a Drupal site across many dimensions and presents the results as a report under Reports > Audit, on the command line via Drush, and (optionally) in the DruScan multi-site portal. The base module ships no checks of its own: it defines an AuditAnalyzer plugin type (PHP 8 attribute #[AuditAnalyzer], plugin manager plugin.manager.audit_analyzer, base class AuditAnalyzerBase) and the surrounding machinery — a report controller, a settings form, a runner service, State-API score storage, a component/render builder, a DruScan API client, and a cron scheduler with two queue workers. Each concern is a small submodule that registers one analyzer plugin. audit_all is a meta-module that enables all production-ready analyzers at once.

Analyzers run on demand (opening a detail page or clicking Run all audits re-runs the check live; nothing is cached), and only the resulting numeric scores plus issue counts are persisted in the State API. Results are shown as Lighthouse-style score circles, collapsible issue sections with severity counters, and client-side faceted filters. The Drush commands (audit:list, audit:run, audit:filters) emit AI-optimized JSON with a --filter and a --fail-on gate, making the framework usable as a CI quality gate for AI-generated or hand-written code. An optional DruScan integration submits scores, a module inventory, and system-version data to a central dashboard so an agency can watch many sites from one place.

Submodules include: audit_status (server/PHP/DB/core compatibility), audit_cron (cron + queues), audit_modules (module/theme landscape), audit_updates (pending + security updates), audit_security (security misconfiguration), audit_performance (aggregation, BigPipe, page cache), audit_cache (cache bins/backends/tags), audit_database (table sizes, primary keys), audit_entity (content volume, revisions, translations), audit_fields (unused fields, view/form modes), audit_blocks (block placement + cache), audit_menu (menu depth), audit_i18n (multilingual + translation coverage), audit_images (image styles, responsive, lazy-load), audit_seo/audit_url/audit_views/audit_watchdog, and the dev-only code-analysis analyzers audit_phpcs, audit_phpstan, audit_phpunit, audit_complexity (phploc), audit_duplication (jscpd), audit_twig, plus audit_search_api.
